# Store Radio audio

Music: user-selected YouTube video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vxPrlc2rtuk
Played using YouTube's official embedded player. The music is not copied into this project.

Crowd ambience: “BerlinGameScene.com Crowd Mumble 1” by BerlinGameScene.com.
Source: https://freesound.org/people/BerlinGameScene/sounds/267251/
License: CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Local file: crowd-murmur.mp3 (public MP3 preview).
The recording is crowd chatter from an event, used as a quiet supermarket-like background.
Playback uses short random excerpts, a low-pass filter, reduced volume and gentle fades.
